description: One company's hiring at a glance: open roles counted by department and by location, remote share, salary ranges per currency where the job board publishes pay, and which roles opened or closed in the last 7 or 30 days from a daily record of every board. company.description: Company or board name (e.g. stripe), or a careers URL on Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever or Workable.
